title: One Room Jogyo-nim
synopsis:
The moment university student Song Uyun arrives at the school admin office, he falls in love at first sight with Woo Jinhyeong, a graduate student and TA. Although Jinhyeong's standoffish demeanor does not give Uyun much opportunity to interact with his crush, Uyun finds the courage and confesses his feelings. To his surprise, Jinhyeong agrees to date him, but without warning Uyun that he is not what he seems.

Soon, the pair begins living together in a studio apartment, where Uyun witnesses Jinhyeong's mask fall off: he has a rather unhealthy interest in adult boys' love series! Jinhyeong might not be what Uyun expected, but he might be just as into the TA's secret wild personality.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
